tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Punctuation for Effect

questions.question: Rewrite this sentence using a colon for emphasis: "She wanted one thing only, revenge."
questions.correctAnswer: She wanted one thing only: revenge.
questions.explanation: Answer: She wanted one thing only: revenge.

questions.question: Rewrite using a semi-colon: "The door slammed. She jumped."
questions.explanation: Answer: The door slammed; she jumped.

questions.question: Add a dash for dramatic effect: "He opened the box and saw something unexpected."
questions.correctAnswer: He opened the box—and saw something unexpected.
questions.explanation: Answer: He opened the box—and saw something unexpected.

questions.question: Rewrite using ellipsis to create suspense: "She heard footsteps getting closer to her door."
questions.correctAnswer: She heard footsteps... getting closer... to her door.
questions.explanation: Answer: She heard footsteps... getting closer... to her door.

questions.question: Correct the punctuation in: "Where are you going" asked Sarah
questions.explanation: Answer: "Where are you going?" asked Sarah.
